_boundary_note: PTF-GRAND-RAPIDS-HOLLAND-MARKET-FACTORY-001. The market has two primary cores: Grand Rapids and Holland. Lansing/East Lansing, Traverse City/Northwest Michigan, and Kalamazoo/Battle Creek are outside scope. Grand Haven, Muskegon, Saugatuck/Douglas, and South Haven were evaluated and excluded as distinct destination markets. Corridors classify independently discovered lodging only; they never define the census.
